archetypes.name: stdout-contract
archetypes.rationale: The fix hinges on preserving the hook-captured stdout contract under quiet env.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the plan and implementation keep `python/cli.py progress report` writing its primary report to real stdout. Check that the regression test would fail when `quiet_init` redirects FD 1. Verify the hook remains fail-open and unchanged. Cite any relevant file paths and test names in your review. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: scope-audit
archetypes.rationale: The design requires a sibling audit without scope creep.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the sibling-command audit boundary. Confirm that only commands with the same captured-stdout deliverable bug are changed inline. Flag any added redesign, hook changes, or ambiguous quiet-contract changes. Cite any relevant file paths and test names in your review. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
